statement.zh: Green & Nissen《乌鲁克古朴文献符号表》（ZATU / ATU 2，1987）是乌鲁克古朴泥板符号表的正式装置，Damerow 与 Englund 参与。
statement.en: Green & Nissen’s Zeichenliste der archaischen Texte aus Uruk (ZATU / ATU 2, 1987), with Damerow and Englund, is the primary sign-list apparatus for archaic Uruk texts.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3.
